data.rationale: The proposal follows the true procedure in the right order (Check my bus → Track my bus → Service Number tab → type service number → select suggestion/submit) and correctly makes the service number the main parameter, but it adds a vague optional 'suggestion to select' parameter and a 'Find my bus' click that was never observed, which makes it slightly harder to automate.
